`qrcode.cjs` is the unmodified JavaScript encoder from `qrcode-generator` 1.4.4 (renamed from `qrcode.js` for CommonJS loading). Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator ; npm tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz . MIT license retained in the source and `QR-LICENSE`. Bundled locally for offline generation; no CDN or runtime package install.
